contracts.composition: The previous character/secondary/shadow bridge is extended with the recovered billboard-first packet dispatcher. It receives explicit camera view and camera-forward vectors; no new live camera producer is claimed. All prior cache/cursor/palette sequencing remains. The source retains the existing normal mesh branch, whose separate evidence is referenced without counting it as new cases.
contracts.precedence: Opcode8f is tested before resolving source meshes, deformation weights or skin matrices. Rigid and smooth layers both reach the billboard writer; smooth palettes are still allocated/prepared by the outer character routine because that work precedes packet selection. Poisoned morph identities are never dereferenced, and the prepared managed replay throws if its mesh resolver is invoked.
contracts.resources: All72 authored GHG billboard records across18 source rigs are tested. The descriptor bytes and source skeleton/layer topology are hash-bound. Controlled relocated handles route each valid layer to the selected billboard descriptor from that same file; exact shipped per-layer mesh/material mapping remains separate.
contracts.verification: 504 new original complete-chain cases, zero differences: 85672 billboard packets, 57528 through shadow records; 98 return-zero cases with packets. Each resource is run under visible, shadow-only, computed visibility, reject-all, no-instance-shadow, reversed/duplicate/invalid map and zero-context/cull scenarios. Whole1MiB persistent image and mask guards, exact writer/record order, layer hashes and flags/cursor agree. No COM lock executes.
contracts.managed: Replay compares full bytes, flags/count/cursor, ordered packets and destination records, submission count and empty COM events. It supplies actual recovered BillboardMeshPackets through the public bridge. Compilation succeeds; managed execution remains pending.
contracts.bounds: Only finite scalar CPU payload behavior, inactive sway/fade and controlled same-layout materials. Camera input production, GPU billboard expansion and final pixels remain separate. Active legacy character shadow queue and mixed billboard/mesh command lists are not newly covered.
